concepts.name: Transcript navigation tools and key-event annotations
concepts.summary: Tools the team had analysis agents build during the first period on OpenAI premises to make transcripts easier to navigate and read, drawing on annotations that pointed out key events.
concepts.explanation: The transcripts were long and numerous, and the team did not read them only through classifier output. During the first period on OpenAI premises, analysis agents were asked to build tools for navigating and reading transcripts, and those tools made use of annotations marking key events within a transcript. The report gives no further detail on what the tools looked like or how the annotations were produced; the appendix records only that they existed and what they were for. They sit alongside the team's own manual reading of many board messages and of selected transcript chunks, most of which an analysis agent had surfaced first.
